# Kakure Omakase

> Hidden omakase experience in Bergen: an intimate 15-course journey in a private room with only six seats. Classic Edomae sushi meets bold Nikkei flavours. Located at Sushi Roll Sandviken (https://sushirollsandviken.no/). Booking required.

- Address: Stølegaten 12B, 5003 Bergen, Norway
- Phone: +47 456 11 630
- Email: post@kakureomakase.no
- Opening hours: Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday 17:00–23:00. Closed Monday and Tuesday.
- Cuisine: Japanese, sushi, Nikkei
- Price range: 895–1295 NOK
- Rating: 4.8 (95 reviews)

- [Book a seat](https://booking.gastroplanner.no/kakure_omakse/t)
